name: Living In A Brothel
source:
You're a 23 years old young man who lives in Priscilla's house, your landlady.
You're an unemployed and you just wants to play video games all day, so you don't pay your rent. Luckily, Priscilla is very fond of your parents and allows you to continue living in her house anyway.

One day, Beatrice, Priscilla's friend, pays a visit and tells her that she's opening a bar.
Priscilla, taking the opportunity, asks if she would have a job for you there, that way you wouldn't have any more excuses for not paying the rent.
Beatrice says yes, there's a job for you at her bar so you're not an unemployed man anymore!

On the way to the bar, Beatrice reveals that you'll be the manager. What you didn't know is that the bar is just a disguise and actually what Beatrice is opening is a brothel.

Among your roles, you will have to: help Beatrice with the decoration of the brothel, be the bartender, be nice to customers, break up fights between customers, take pictures of the girls, create a website to attract new customers and, the best role among all, having sex with the girls to teach them how to treat clients.

You'll certainly have a lot of work managing the brothel, but we hope it'll be a very rewarding experience, especially when you're "training" the girls.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2348820/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你是一位23岁的年轻人，住在你的女房东普里西拉的房子里。
你是一个失业者，你只想整天玩电子游戏，所以你不付房租。幸运的是，普里西拉非常喜欢你的父母，并允许你继续住在她的房子里。

有一天，普里西拉的朋友比阿特丽斯拜访她，并告诉她自己要开一家酒吧。
普里西拉趁机问她是否能为你在那里找到一份工作，这样你就不会再有任何借口不付房租了。
比阿特丽斯说是的，她的酒吧有一份工作适合你，所以你不再是失业者了！

在去酒吧的路上，比阿特丽斯透露你将成为经理。你不知道的是，酒吧只是一个幌子，而贝阿特丽斯开的实际上是一家妓院。

在你的角色中，你必须：帮助比阿特丽斯装饰妓院、担任调酒师、善待顾客、化解顾客之间的争吵、为女孩拍照、创建一个网站来吸引新顾客，而其中最好的角色是与女孩发生性关系，教她们如何对待顾客。

管理妓院肯定会让你做很多工作，但我们希望这将是一次非常有益的经历，尤其是当你“训练”女孩时。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2348820/]Steam[/url]]
